trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court at Chikkaballapura (M.C.No.81/2021)
case_name: Geetha P A vs B N Anil Kumar
facts_of_case: Marriage of the parties was solemnized on 14.10.2016 and they have one child. Respondent/husband initiated M.C.No.81/2021 for dissolution of marriage. Petitioner/wife prays for transfer of petition from Chikkaballapura to Bengaluru.

legal_principles.principle: A court may transfer a petition to another court if it is in the interest of justice and equity.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted that respondent/husband initiated M.C.No.81/2021 on the file of the Principal Judge, Family Court at Chikkaballapura under Section 13(1)(ia)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 for dissolution of marriage.

legal_principles.principle: A party's inability to travel may be a ground for transferring a petition.
legal_principles.held: Hence, she prays for transfer of petition from Chikkaballapura to Bengaluru, since she would not be in a position to travel from Bengaluru to Chikkaballapura.

outcome.final_order: Proceedings in M.C.No.81/2021 pending before the Principal Judge Family Court at Chikkaballapura is directed to be transferred to the Family Court at Bengaluru.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition under Section 24 CPC
advising on divorce proceedings in Bengaluru
